name: Camping Franzlhof
beschreibung: Camping Franzlhof is located in Söll in Tyrol and is designated as a campsite. It is situated on the outskirts of Söll, surrounded by idyllic meadows and woodlands. The site provides spacious pitches for motorhomes and tents. From the campsite, hiking trails and cross-country ski tracks are directly accessible. The property features a guest garden where authentic Tyrolean specialities are served. The sanitary facilities have been recently renovated and meet the highest modern standards.
